entry.title: Getting dressed together
entry.summary: Name the clothes and invite your baby to join in—a reach toward a shirt or an arm into a sleeve—with help as needed.
entry.cue: While you are changing your baby’s clothes.
detail: Tell your baby what you are about to do. You can offer two suitable tops and notice where they look or reach, or hold a sleeve ready and see whether they join in.
Use gentle hands and leave time for a response. Some days you will do more of the dressing; participation is an invitation, and necessary care can still go ahead gently.
